Your week in three swipes 📆

Kanye broke his own U.S. hip-hop attendance record in Houston and brought out Playboi Carti, Drake is sitting on 11 albums on the Billboard 200 at once (the most of any artist right now), and Benny The Butcher teased A Friend Of Ours 2 with a new single, Elevate, alongside Black Soprano Family. Which one are you most locked in on?

Be early to what's next. Join the Riffex waitlist, link in bio.
